name: rops_frame_pushover

spec.name: rops_frame_pushover
spec.title: 横転の保護枠: 車体の骨組全部を塑性ヒンジで押し、動いた形で乗員の空間との隙間を測る

checks.case: fixed-base square portal 1000 x 1000 mm, square tube 40 x 40 x 2.3 mm, f_y 215 MPa: side load at a top corner, collapse load
checks.source: closed form, textbook plastic analysis: sway mechanism of a fixed-base portal H_c = 4 M_p / h, M_p = Z_p f_y, Z_p = (b h^2 - (b - 2t)(h - 2t)^2) / 4 (Neal, The Plastic Methods of Structural Analysis), worked out by hand

checks.case: the same portal: load down at mid-span of the top beam, collapse load
checks.source: closed form, textbook plastic analysis: beam mechanism with a central load V_c = 8 M_p / L (Neal, The Plastic Methods of Structural Analysis), worked out by hand

reason: R4 (横転の保護枠、R4-rops) を解析するツールが棚に無い (list_tools(test_id=R4) が空)。手計算はロールバーとレールの切れ端だけの門形の枠なので、車体の骨組全部を車輪の取付点で固定して塑性ヒンジで押し、動いた形で乗員の空間との隙間を測るツールを足す。
